context: Asuka confirms a class time with Sakura.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: class scheduling; vocabulary (先ほど/時刻/とおり/午前/前回) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、次の授業はいつですか?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 前回どおり、午前の授業です。
lines.en: As last time, it's a morning class.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 時刻は、変わっていませんか?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 先ほどの連絡のとおり、変わりません。
lines.en: As the notice just now said, it's unchanged.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 前回の宿題も、提出ですか?
lines.en: Do we submit last time's homework too?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、前回の分も午前に集めます。
lines.en: Yes, I'll collect last time's in the morning too.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 時刻に、遅れないようにします。
lines.en: I'll make sure not to be late.
lines.style: resolved adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 先ほど伝えたとおり、楽しみにしていますね。
lines.en: As I said just now, I look forward to it.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
